messages:
maya: Quick sync — need alignment on private-offer structure for the upcoming joint HW + SI launch. Main asks: how do we stack upfront credits vs committed spend without cannibalizing the public marketplace listing?

raj: Agree. Biggest risk is customers picking the private deal solely for onboarding credits. Suggest tiered commit with phased credit release tied to consumption.

elena: Partner POV: they'd like a visible public discount on the listing + additional onboarding credits in the PO. Can the PO credits be time-limited so they don’t reduce long-term ARR?

tom: Ops constraints: billing system can’t mix marketplace promotional credits with private-offer SKUs by default. We need explicit mapping: listing SKU -> PO SKU -> credit bucket. Also track expiry.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace policy requires all resell/onboarding credits to be disclosed in offer metadata and in the private-offer description.

maya: Proposed approach: 1) baseline public listing discount (keeps market price signal), 2) private-offer onboarding credit (time-limited, non-refundable), 3) renewal kicker that converts a portion of unused credits into a one-time renewal discount (to encourage renewals instead of churn). Thoughts? :thinking_face:

raj: Add minimum usage floors per quarter on the PO so credits aren’t used to game short-term consumption. Also define a clear churn clawback if commit not met.

elena: Partners are ok with a 6-month floor. We need a simple forecast template for sales to set realistic commits.

tom: I’ll own the SKU mapping and enforceable metadata. Quick mapping snippet for ops (will formalize in PR):

```
mapping = {
  "listing_sku": "redwood-pro-100",
  "po_sku": "rwd-po-100-yr1",
  "credit_bucket": "onboarding_credits",
  "credit_value": "$50k",
  "expires": "90d",
  "renewal_kicker": "convert_50pct_unused_to_renewal_discount"
}
```

maya: Can Sales own the forecast template and Legal sign off on the renewal T&Cs? @raj @elena

raj: I’ll draft the forecast template and loop in Legal next week.

elena: :thumbsup: include this renewal clause language: 'Unused onboarding credits may be applied to the next renewal at 50% value, subject to usage floor being met.'

maya: Capture action items: Raj — draft forecast & renewal clause (due Fri), Tom — publish ops SKU mapping and metadata (due Wed EOD), Elena — confirm partner acceptance and any redlines (due Thu).

tom: Noted. I’ll open a PR in infra/marketplace and ping here when it’s ready.

marketplace-bot: Update: private-offer metadata schema extended with fields: credit_bucket, credit_expiry, renewal_kicker. Remember to include disclosures when creating the PO.

maya: Thanks all — will sync in next week’s partner ops call if anything blocks.
